title: Your first Night Planning,
excerpt: What each of the five evening steps is for, and how to move through them quickly.
lede: Each evening, Jamaal offers to plan tomorrow with you. Here's what each of the five steps is for, and how to get through them quickly.

body.html: You'll get one gentle nudge at the planning time you chose during setup. You can change it in Settings. Tap the nudge, or the moon in Today's toolbar, to begin.

items.title: Review today
items.body: Plain counts of what got done and how long it took, set against your estimates. Nothing to do here but look. It helps your guesses get better.

items.title: Carry forward
items.body: For each thing left over, choose keep, later or drop. The third time something is pushed, Jamaal asks for a date. That's usually the moment to be honest about it.

items.title: Build tomorrow
items.body: Tomorrow's fixed points, with the free gaps between them named. Add tasks and see which gap they'd fit. A task longer than any gap is flagged, so you can split it or move it.

items.title: Check the load
items.body: Choose how much energy tomorrow has: low, medium or high. If the plan runs over, Jamaal suggests one move. You can take it or keep your plan.

items.title: Close the day
items.body: Tomorrow is ready. That’s it. Good night.

body.html: Nothing breaks. In the morning, Today offers a shorter version of the same flow: build today, check the load, and go. Or just ignore it. Your list is still there, in order.
